name: Rizuhble's Slow Roast Infernus
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Afterburn T3, Concussive Combustion unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Mystic Vulnerability, weapon 4.8k at Toxic Bullets. Ultimate (Concussive Combustion) is available from Mystic Vulnerability.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 7 per second to Flame Dash's damage per second (0.70x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Mystic Vulnerability completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Toxic Bullets, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Afterburn: its duration-scaled parts (build up duration 17s, burn duration 3s) get +22%.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 12.6 per second to Flame Dash's damage per second (0.70x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Toxic Bullets, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-20,800 (levels 16-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Napalm T3. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Healbane.

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Healbane, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Healbane completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Healbane completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Healbane
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k weapon tier, which Titanic Magazine completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Titanic Magazine completes 6.4k weapon in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Titanic Magazine
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell it for a second counter.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Concussive Combustion stun duration (1.2s), Afterburn build up duration (17s), Napalm debuff duration (8s). Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-44,800 (levels 27-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Flame Dash T3.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 45 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.
sections.desc: Dying after Healbane? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Kelvin, Geist, Vyper.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Flame Dash (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep stopping you before you can ult.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 29.2 to Concussive Combustion's damage (0.97x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Same-slot upgrade of Improved Spirit for 4,800 more souls: tech power 18 to 30..

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Swift Striker for this, or Burst Fire if it's gone.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 25,600 to 30,400 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Sell Titanic Magazine for this, or Superior Duration if it's gone.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Ricochet when their frontline stacks bullet resist.
